job.title: Online Communication Consultant @ ICF (Brussels, BRU, BE)
job.description:
Description

ICF NEXT is seeking an experienced **Online Communication Consultant** to support strategic communication activities linked to major European initiatives in the fields of **STEM education, digital education, skills and artificial intelligence**. In this position you will be working from one of our clients' premises.

The initiatives aim to strengthen science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) education, develop a stronger and more inclusive talent pipeline, increase the participation of women in STEM, and help education systems respond to rapid technological developments.

A strong focus is placed on **digital and AI literacy**, support to schools and educators, digital wellbeing and online safety, innovation in education, and collaboration between education, industry, policymakers and other stakeholders.

Communication and stakeholder engagement play a central role in the successful implementation of these initiatives. This includes promoting key policy messages, sharing good practices and project results, communicating funding and research opportunities, and engaging diverse stakeholder communities in cross-sectoral dialogue.

### **CONTRACT OBJECTIVE**

The consultant will support the **communication, outreach and stakeholder engagement** activities associated with European policy initiatives in STEM, digital education and skills.

The role will contribute to:

* Promoting policy activities, research outputs, funding opportunities and project results.
* Translating complex policy topics into clear and engaging communications for different audiences.
* Increasing awareness and visibility of initiatives related to STEM, education, digital skills and AI.
* Engaging a diverse range of stakeholders, including representatives from the education sector, public authorities, industry and the private sector.
* Supporting both **online and offline communications** around emerging priorities in digital education and skills.
* Providing strategic advice and operational support for stakeholder engagement activities.

### **TASKS / REQUIRED SERVICES**

Key responsibilities will include:

Strategic communication and digital engagement

* Provide **strategic advice and hands-on support** for online and offline communication activities.
* Identify and recommend emerging **digital communication trends, tools, channels and methodologies**.
* Support the development and implementation of digital communication actions targeting stakeholders across the STEM and digital education ecosystem.
* Analyse stakeholder positions and communication needs.
* Conduct **SWOT analyses** and recommend appropriate strategic approaches on STEM, digital education and skills topics.

Content strategy and editorial support

* Support all stages of the **content strategy lifecycle**, including planning, analysis, creation, testing, review and maintenance.
* Develop digital content for websites and social media channels.
* Propose editorial concepts and approaches for different audiences and communication objectives.
* Research and compile background information and analyse policy and technical documentation.
* Write, edit, rewrite and adapt **high-quality original content**.
* Translate complex or technical information into accessible content for different stakeholder groups.
* Develop editorial approaches and content for social media platforms.
* Manage editorial projects and carry out quality control of communication materials.
* Monitor relevant online and print media.

Stakeholder engagement and coordination

* Participate in meetings related to implementation, communication activities and project progress.
* Draft reports, meeting summaries and other supporting documentation.
* Support **working groups, expert groups, stakeholder events and other engagement activities**.
* Contribute to dialogue with stakeholders from the education, public and private sectors.
* Prepare and deliver **presentations** to different audiences, including stakeholders, experts and visitors.

Project and administrative support

* Provide general coordination and administrative support related to the communication portfolio.
* Coordinate translation requests and support mailbox management.
* Track service requests, deliverables and ongoing tasks.
* Support document management and reporting.
* Use relevant **project management, communication and administrative tools** to ensure activities are delivered effectively.

### **KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS**

The ideal candidate will bring:

* **5+ years of relevant professional experience**.
* Strong knowledge of developments, trends, tools and methodologies related to **digital and online communication**.
* Experience with **content strategy, website content and social media communication**.
* Strong writing, editing and content adaptation skills.
* Experience in **stakeholder engagement and strategic communication**.
* Knowledge of or interest in **STEM, education, digital skills, AI or related policy areas** would be highly advantageous.
* Experience in project, service and/or quality management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* A user- and customer-focused mindset.
* Ability to work effectively within an **international and multicultural environment**.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative and collaborate effectively within a team.
* Strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Leadership capability.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

### **LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS**

**English: C1 level**

* Understanding: C1
* Speaking: C1
* Writing: C1

### **EXPERIENCE**

**Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience.**

**#Indeed #LI-CC1**

**Bot and Third-Party Applications**

Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance.

**Working at ICF**

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

**Candidate AI Usage Policy**

At ICF, we are committed to ensuring a fair and equitable interview process for all candidates based on their own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to generate or assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is not permitted. This policy is in place to maintain the integrity and authenticity of the interview process.

However, we understand that some candidates may require accommodations that involve the use of AI. If such an accommodation is needed, candidates are instructed to contact us in advance at candidateaccommodation@icf.com. We are dedicated to providing the necessary support to ensure that all candidates have an equal opportunity to succeed.

job.title: CRM & Loyalty Deployment Manager - (F/H) @ Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
**Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield develops and operates a portfolio of premium, sustainable mixed-use real estate assets in the most dynamic cities across Europe and the United States.**

  

**Reinvent Being Together**

Driven by our purpose, we are committed to accelerating urban regeneration and helping to rethink the way we live together in cities. We create and operate sustainable, unique destinations that reinvent togetherness. At the heart of our destinations, we design inspiring and distinctive experiences that foster new opportunities for interaction and connection between visitors and brands.

**A Sustainable Approach**

Sustainability lies at the core of our business. As a leader in our industry, we are committed to continuing our active contribution to the environmental transition of cities toward carbon neutrality.

  

**Together at URW**

The Group’s 2,000 employees work together to imagine and operate sustainable destinations, placing users at the center of everything they do. These destinations act as catalysts for the vitality and growth of the communities and territories in which they are developed.

  

**Context :**

  

**6-month fixed-term contract | Maternity leave cover | January to May 2027, with the possibility of extension depending on maternity leave arrangements.**

  

Within the Marketing Department, the CRM & Loyalty team supports the Group’s strategy to create business value from visitor engagement. Its role is to increase footfall and sales across our shopping centres while developing new opportunities and capabilities for our business partners, including retailers and brands.

Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engagement, the CRM & Loyalty Deployment Manager (H/F) will contribute to refining the loyalty value proposition and lead its operational activation, content strategy and performance management across markets.

The successful candidate will join the project at a pivotal stage: moving from the definition of the new loyalty programme to operational readiness, implementation in our loyalty tool, and deployment with pilot countries and centres.

  

**Your role :**

  

Turn the programme’s value proposition and playbook into concrete, consistent and scalable activations for pilot markets. This includes content, CRM journeys, deployment materials and performance-monitoring frameworks that support a successful transition from concept to execution.

  

**Key responsibilities :**

  

**Prepare and coordinate programme deployment**

  

* Lead the operational preparation and launch plan for the pilots, including milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions and owners.
* Coordinate Group teams, countries, pilot centres and external partners to secure deliverables and decisions.
* Translate the target model into an actionable playbook and toolkit: Group standards, non-negotiable elements, scope for local adaptation and replication guidelines.
Prepare local teams through briefs, materials, coordination meetings, needs gathering and readiness tracking.  

  

**Implement activations and journeys in the Group loyalty platform**

  

* Translate acquisition, engagement and reactivation journeys into clear, actionable CRM requirements.
* Coordinate the functional configuration of campaigns, segments, content and loyalty mechanics in our loyalty tool with CRM, Digital, IT and Data teams and partners.
* Contribute to feasibility workshops, document decisions, track blockers and organise business acceptance testing before launch.
Ensure omnichannel consistency across email, push notifications, the app, website, Wallet and in-centre materials, according to the agreed scope.  

  

**Manage programme content and tactical activations**

  

* Coordinate production, approval, localisation and integration of CRM and loyalty content: emails, push notifications, landing pages, challenges, offers, benefits and activation materials.
* Ensure quality, brand consistency and clarity of the member proposition across all touchpoints.
* Build and execute the seasonal activation calendar for key retail moments (Christmas, Black Friday, Valentine's Day) to drive footfall and loyalty engagement.
Coordinate the design and deployment of digital activations and on-site treasure-hunt mechanics across shopping centres, combining gamification, storytelling and 360° communication assets.  

  

**Measure, analyse and recommend**

  

* Define the pilot measurement framework and dashboard with the team: acquisition, activation, participation, completion, engagement, reactivation, and available traffic or business-value indicators.
* Monitor results, identify friction points and produce concrete optimisation recommendations.
* Consolidate feedback from pilot countries and centres to distinguish local adjustments from changes required to the Group model.
Prepare clear, decision-oriented summaries for project governance bodies and management.  

  

**Contribute to offers and partnerships**

  

* Support the qualification and activation of retailer or partner offers relevant to the programme.
* Coordinate the operational development and deployment of the Cashback programme with payment partners, including partner follow-up and performance tracking.
* Contribute to operational monitoring and measurement of tests involving offers, benefits or cashback mechanics when included in the pilot scope.
Ensure proposed activations create clear value for members, markets, centres and partners.  

  

**Candidate Profile**

  

* Four to seven years of experience in CRM, loyalty, customer engagement or digital marketing, ideally in retail, hospitality, luxury or another B2C environment.
* Hands-on experience deploying or managing a loyalty programme, automated journeys or omnichannel activations.
* Operational proficiency with a CRM or marketing automation platform. Experience with Brevo is a plus; Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Selligent or Braze are also relevant.
* Demonstrated experience in a multi-country or multi-entity environment, with the ability to drive stakeholders forward without direct line authority.
* Strong project-management skills: scoping, prioritisation, dependency tracking, agency coordination and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills: defining KPIs, interpreting performance, developing recommendations and producing decision-oriented summaries.
* Strong editorial awareness and experience managing CRM content, with close attention to brand and customer experience.
Full professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken.  

**Our Benefits**

  

**Compensation Package**

* Attractive fixed salary paid over 13 months
* Annual performance-based bonus
* Profit-sharing and incentive schemes

**Transportation**

* Betterway mobility program, allowing you to choose the mobility solution that suits you best:
* 100% reimbursement of the Navigo pass, or
* €700 per year if you opt for electric mobility
* Green mobility offering, including an electric bike fleet

**Health & Well-being**

* Comprehensive health insurance with supplementary coverage (included for €1.10)
* Life and disability insurance

**Meals**

* Meal voucher card and/or access to the company restaurant (guaranteed 100% fresh, seasonal products)

**Time Off**

* 30 days of paid vacation
* 5 to 6 RTT days per year

**A Collaborative and Friendly Workplace**

* On-site café with a barista preparing personalized hot beverages
* Friday morning brunch
* Coffee bean machines, tea, and water (still, sparkling, and hot) available throughout the day

**Sports & Fitness**

* Free access to the gym, with a coach available every lunchtime (€90/year membership)
* Premium showers and changing rooms worthy of a 5-star hotel, with all amenities included

**Additional Perks**

* Laundry/ironing service
* Parcel reception service

**Learning & Development**

* Access to training programs through the URW Academy

**Social & Environmental Responsibility**

* Strong anti-waste policy
* Community Days: one mandatory volunteer day per year for all employees, with a choice of four high-impact social and/or environmental initiatives

**Works Council (CSE)**

* Dedicated and engaged employee representatives with an online platform

**Parental Support**

* Comprehensive parental policy, including:
* Partnership with Babilou for childcare placements
* Coaching support for parents
* Option to return on a 4-day workweek while maintaining 100% salary during the first month after parental leave
* Salary continuation during maternity leave
* One paid day off for the first day of the school year
Between 6 and 12 days of paid leave for caring for sick children  

**Location**

  

Position based at **7 Place du Chancelier Adenauer, Paris 16th arrondissement** (nearest metro stations: **Porte Dauphine** and **Victor Hugo** ).

  

**What Matters to Us**

What matters most to us is welcoming committed and passionate individuals who bring positive energy to those around them and are eager to grow within a leading international group.

We offer our employees a collaborative and innovative culture focused on success and designed to create unique career development opportunities. We strive for excellence, while encouraging autonomy, innovation, and collective intelligence.

If you are looking for intellectually stimulating and meaningful work, where teamwork and daily challenges are at the heart of the experience, we encourage you to apply.

  

**Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield** is committed to equal opportunity and values diversity in backgrounds, experiences, and skills. We believe diversity plays a key role in our success and are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment that respects, values, celebrates, and leverages individual differences.

As a signatory of the Diversity Charter, Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield evaluates every application fairly, without discrimination based on disability, age, gender, origin, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.title: Paris Office - Life Sciences Specialist (m/f/d) (for PhD and MD applicants only) - March 2027 @ L.E.K. Consulting (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
Location

Paris

Job Description

**About L.E.K. Consulting**

L.E.K. Consulting is a global strategy consulting firm that addresses the most critical commercial issues for the leaders of some of the world's most successful businesses.

Clients come to us time and again because we are proven to act as an insightful expert and a trusted partner. We are uncompromising in our approach to help clients make better decisions at crucial moments, changing the trajectory of their enterprise, delivering improved business performance and creating greater shareholder returns.

Our teams combine our core capabilities of research, benchmarking, modelling, data & analytics and strategy development to create game-changing insights and practical solutions that seize competitive advantage and unlock new growth opportunities. We enable clients to make critical decisions with greater certainty and empower them to master their moments of truth.

With more than 2,300 professionals located across five continents, L.E.K. specialises in Strategy and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) support with clients across the full range of corporates and private equity. We are expert in a wide range of industries, including Life Sciences and healthcare, retail and consumer, financial services, industrials, energy and transportation.

**The Life Sciences Specialist position**

Joining the European L.E.K. Life Sciences team will enable you to develop a world-class foundation in commercial problem-solving as you address the issues that face today’s business leaders. A wide variety of projects will give you experience of all aspects of commercial activity. The nature and pace of L.E.K.’s strategic work facilitates the rapid development of a highly analytical skill set in a collaborative and rewarding team-based environment. As you progress you will take on a significant level of responsibility and build your leadership skills.

With their technical backgrounds, Life Sciences Specialists form a vital part of our team. This dedicated pathway:

* recognises the scientific, medical and technical expertise that you bring to projects from day one
* allows you to dedicate yourself to an industry with which you are already familiar and for which you have a passion
* is a platform for you to build on your technical skills while learning new commercial capabilities
* provides you with an opportunity to follow an accelerated career path

As a Life Sciences Specialist, you will contribute to projects in many ways:

* Research: conduct critical primary and secondary research to influence client recommendations, e.g. interview scientific experts and key opinion leaders, review medical literature
* Analyse: conduct quantitative analysis, undertake database manipulation, build sophisticated financial models and interpret complex data
* Communicate: translate scientific and medical data and concepts to advise business strategy
* Solve: build on medical and scientific findings of the team to contribute to the overall case-solving process and to answer the client’s key questions
* Manage: from early on, get first-hand experience of managing Associate team members

**Who we are looking for**

We are currently seeking exceptional and committed individuals with the ability to solve complex problems in a creative way. Along with **previous experience, studies or a strong interest into economics and business strategy related to the Life Sciences sector**, you will have **achieved a PhD or MD/MBBS**.

Successful candidates typically possess outstanding academic achievements, are comfortable with quantitative analysis, have excellent verbal and written communication skills in French and English, relevant professional experience, and notable extracurricular interests. Fluency in another European language is considered an asset.

We are looking for a sense of intellectual curiosity that will inspire you to develop a deep understanding of any client situation, and to generate innovative answers to complex questions. We want people with the ability to think in logical, structured ways, together with the creativity to look beyond the obvious.

Our team-oriented approach requires individuals who can collaborate and communicate well. We seek proactive, energetic, and enthusiastic candidates who take ownership of their work and make a meaningful impact.

**What we offer**

**Training and development**  
The Life Science Specialist position at L.E.K. is a launch-pad for your career. You will be supported with a comprehensive initial two-week orientation programme, followed by thorough monthly training sessions designed to complement your on-the-job experience. These cover the full range of skills needed to develop and progress your career within L.E.K., allowing promotion to the Consultant role without attaining an MBA.

**International experience and exchange programme**  
L.E.K. offers you the opportunity to swap to one of our global offices for six months. This is a popular way to experience a different business environment, gain exposure to new industries and specialisms and experience a different culture. In addition, you will often work with colleagues from other offices, on projects with an international scope.

**Application Process**

Our application process is now open for positions starting in March 2027.

Please upload your application documents (cover letter, CV, references) on our career site. Please state your desired start date in your cover letter.

After completing the online application process, selected candidates will be contacted by our Recruitment Team and invited to a numerical reasoning test followed by a series of interviews. Applicants stating 'fluency' in a language will have this assessed during the recruitment process. Please note that fluency in both French and English are a requirement for this position.

**Application deadline: 29th November 2026 at 23:55pm CET**

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

**Diversity and inclusion at L.E.K.**

Here at L.E.K., we appreciate the value of a diverse and inclusive workforce and are committed to a culture that is inclusive and accepting of all people. Above all, we are committed to ensuring that all employees are treated with respect and dignity. L.E.K. Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We have several affinity groups to support and enrich our employees and in addition, our Diversity and Inclusion committee celebrate events throughout the year with a focus on awareness and education.

job.title: Advisory Consultant @ OMP (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
**Your challenge**
------------------

  

As an **Advisory Consultant**, you help our customers optimize their supply chain. You contribute to designing their ideal supply chain planning cycle and organization by analyzing their needs and challenges and reviewing their processes and roles. You combine your industry expertise with business insights to support supply chain leaders with strategic advice.

You are responsible for:

* Analyzing your customers' supply chain needs and challenges, reviewing current processes and roles, and defining the project scope.
* Defining the ideal supply chain planning landscape and cycle, based on OMP's Unison Planning.
* Enriching data analyses of forecasts, inventory plans and other planning data with business insights.
* Developing business cases and performing maturity assessments.
* Validating and (re)aligning your results with all stakeholders involved.
* Supporting senior colleagues in delivering expert advice to new prospects and building partnerships with existing customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

A bachelor's or master's degree in supply chain management, business, engineering, or similar

3+ years of experience in a similar role (2+ years for internal candidates).

Knowledge of supply chain management solutions and a strong interest in software and technology.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to absorbing information and using AI tools.

Excellent communication, presentation, networking and negotiation skills, and solid experience in collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

The ability to work autonomously and the flexibility to travel up to 25% of your time.

Bonus points if you have:

Business knowledge in one of our core industries: chemicals, consumer goods, life sciences, metals, paper, plastic film, or packaging.

  

**Soft skills**

* Analytical
* Communicative
* Customer-focused
* Negotiator
* Global team player

**Hard skills**

* Supply chain management
* Industry knowledge (e.g. chemicals, metals)
* Stakeholder management
* Data analysis

**Language skills**

Required:

* English

A plus:

* Dutch

* French

* German

**Your future**
---------------

We find the perfect intersection of your talents and our evolving needs. Our talent management program supports your personal development and empowers you to build a career in line with your ambitions.

Many of our team members who start as advisory consultants grow into roles in advisory management, project management or business development.

job.title: Global Brand Strategy Lead, Allegra @ Opella. (Neuilly-sur-Seine, A8, FR)
job.description:
**Salary Range:**

€88 800,00 - €118 200,00

All Compensation will be determined commensurate with demonstrated experience.

‎

Global Brand Strategy Lead You’ve built experience, now use it where bold ideas meet real impact. At Opella, we’re challenging how self-care works for millions of people and need leaders and experts ready to shape what’s next. As a Global Brand Strategy Lead, you’ll bring your skill, your curiosity and your drive to make health simpler, smarter and more human. About the job: The Global Brand Strategy Lead contributes to the long-term strategic direction and drives short and mid-term executional excellence to grow Allegra brand share and volume in global allergy including driving content creation strategy for the different target audiences and channels and executional direction and playbooks for markets to adopt and win. Lead initiatives that advance our brands and strengthen our reputation worldwide. Mentor and uplift emerging talent while pushing your own growth and influence. Put purpose into practice — embedding sustainability, access and social impact into every decision. Model the challenger mindset: question complexity, act with integrity and make things radically simple. Help shape a culture that’s ambitious, collaborative and serious about recognition and belonging. Main responsibilities: the Global Brand Strategy Lead Defines brand equity, brand positioning and long-term strategic plan, leveraging inputs from Insights and ZBLs on consumer & shopper insights, demand analysis, competitive intel., content strategy, financial results, innovation pipeline, etc Defines brand assets (logos, typography, taglines, etc.) Defines with the GBGM the brand campaign strategy (timing, positioning, budget) Leads a cross-functional dialogue to get alignment on the brand strategy by developing respective functional tactical plans meeting the strategic imperatives of the brand. Is the focal point of contact responsible for A&P allocation and follow-up of the brand global budget. Reviews and make recommendations to optimize marketing and business development strategies based on MMM learnings, Leads the content creation and orchestrate the global brand team to provide an E2E experience plan including Go Big on Social. Lead, develop, implement a portfolio support model, including but not restricted to media, A&P that can help achieve brand vision and bring to life new brand architecture and develops playbooks for markets to adopt Tracks monthly brand performance (actuals & KPIs, on marketing & financials aspects) and support Global GM & Zone leads to achieve objectives on market share, sales volume growth, brand equity, and brand health. Build strong, strategic partnerships with global creative and media agencies, as well as with Innovation and HCP leads, Shopper and XP planning across the brand Actively mentors and provides input to Global Brand Lead About You Education Graduate degree in Marketing, Management degree/MBA (preferable) Languages Fluency in English in a professional context spoken and written is a must. Skills & Competencies You are a highly strategic and well-rounded marketer with a strong blend of business acumen, brand expertise, and commercial understanding. You have a proven ability to develop compelling communication platforms and creative strategies that drive brand growth and business performance with a Global mindset. You excel at managing external agencies and cross-functional stakeholders, building strong partnerships and delivering results through influence rather than direct authority. Your ability to navigate complex environments, prioritize effectively, and make sound decisions enables you to drive initiatives forward with confidence. You bring a solid understanding of commercial and marketing fundamentals, for end-to-end brand planning and long-range forecasting, to delivery of broader business objectives. Equally comfortable in strategic discussions and executive presentations, you possess the gravitas, presence, and communication skills required to engage and influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic alignment across markets. You have demonstrated global perspective with multi market experience. A confident presenter and persuasive communicator, you are passionate about shaping brand and business strategy while inspiring others around a shared vision. This is more than the next step in your career, it’s a chance to lead change and help reinvent self-care for the world. If you’re ready to challenge, inspire and deliver impact that matters, we’re ready for you. We are challengers. We are Opella. Opella values diversity in all its forms and is committed to fostering a workplace where everyone can belong and excel. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. About Us: Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally. Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting. At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at www.opella.com. #GD-SA #LI-SA #LI-HYBRID

job.title: BRAND & PRODUCT LEARNING PROGRAM EXPERT - ADIDAS @ WorkShop - The Consumer Experience Agency (Paris, A8, FR)
job.description:
WorkShop is now looking for a Brand & Product Learning Program Expert for a consulting assignment with adidas in Paris, France, until the end of December 2027. In this role, you will manage the local implementation and execution of adidas’ European Brand & Product Learning Program, ensuring high-quality delivery across digital and in-person training. You will drive impactful learning experiences, monitor program performance against key success criteria, and ensure training initiatives support the development of sales teams across the local market.

Working closely with internal and external stakeholders, you will adapt and implement learning programs in line with brand priorities, key product launches and major campaigns. By strengthening product knowledge and sales capabilities, you will help retail teams bring adidas products to life and drive sell-out. Does this sound interesting? Keep reading!

**Key Responsibilities**

You will be responsible for the local execution of the program across 5–10 key accounts and partner stores, ensuring alignment with European objectives, KPIs and business priorities. Your responsibilities will include:

* Program Implementation & Performance: Ensure the program is delivered in line with European objectives, KPIs and success criteria. Monitor results, evaluate performance and identify best practices to drive continuous improvement.
* Product Learning & Local Adaptation: Adapt training programs and content to local market needs and business priorities, focusing on Running, Football, Training and Outdoor. Select and regularly review participating stores based on global and European business strategies.
* Stakeholder & Partner Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with European and local stakeholders. Act as a key point of contact between the external agency and local teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment and smooth program delivery.
* Trainer Management & Development: Support the management and performance follow-up of external Product Trainers. Provide structured feedback and reporting to internal stakeholders and the agency to evaluate training quality and local execution.
* Digital Learning & Engagement: Support retail partners in adopting digital learning tools, working closely with Account Managers to implement the program across digital channels. Engage with the wider Product Trainer Community to strengthen collaboration and knowledge-sharing between field teams and retail partners.
* Training Delivery & Resources: Coordinate internal and external stakeholders to deliver high-quality training for wholesale partners. Support the development of training materials and coordinate resources to ensure effective and consistent delivery. Use tools such as Excel and PowerPoint to track activities, analyse performance and prepare reports.

**Who You Are**

You are a proactive, organised and business-minded professional with a passion for retail, product learning and customer experience. You enjoy taking ownership of projects, coordinating stakeholders and translating business objectives into measurable learning initiatives. With strong planning and project management skills, a consumer-first approach and a digital mindset, you understand how effective training can strengthen sales performance in an omnichannel retail environment. You are comfortable working independently, managing multiple priorities and using data to evaluate performance and identify opportunities for improvement. To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

* At least 3 years of experience in retail sales, retail training or marketing activation, preferably within the apparel, sportswear or sporting goods industry
* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification
* Fluency in both English and French
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Strong planning, project management and organisational skills
* Good analytical skills and confidence working with numbers, business KPIs and performance reporting
* Strong business acumen and a solid understanding of omnichannel retail and business KPIs
* Knowledge of adult learning principles and training effectiveness measurement
* The ability to build and maintain effective relationships with stakeholders and customers
* Excellent communication, presentation and collaboration skills, including active listening and the ability to ask effective questions

**Practical information**

**Location**: Paris, France  
**Start date**: As soon as possible or according to agreement  
**Working hours**: Full-time  
**Employment type**: Consulting assignment through WorkShop until the end of December 2027

Join a team committed to developing people, improving performance and driving meaningful retail impact. Apply now to play a key role in managing the local implementation of adidas’ Brand & Product Learning Program across retail partners in France. Application deadline: 2026-10-31.

*We are WorkShop: the Consumer Experience Agency – a leading retail agency in the Nordics, dedicated to creating and delivering innovative customer experience for the world's biggest brands. We do that by offering a complete portfolio of services including data & insights, concept, field marketing and much more – so that we can be a partner to our clients in every step. Join one of our teams around the globe and explore your potential through unique projects, pop-ups, store concepts or our brand ambassador programs!*

**Learn more about our company at** **WorkShop** **and follow us on** **Facebook****,** **LinkedIn** **and** **Instagram****!**

job.title: Online marketeer & tekstschrijver (20 tot 24 uur) @ Dunique (Apeldoorn, GE, NL)
job.description:
Jij helpt onze klanten zichtbaar te worden! Bij Dunique werk je voor kleine en middelgrote bedrijven uit de omgeving. Ze zijn werkzaam in allerlei verschillende branches, van de techniek tot horeca en van transport tot de bouw. Jij zorgt samen met je collega’s dat deze bedrijven een zichtbaar merk worden én blijven.

Wij zijn op zoek naar een creatieve marketeer voor 20 tot 24 uur per week. Ben jij creatief, enthousiast en klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging? Dan komen we graag met je in contact. Word jij onze nieuwe collega?

**Als online marketeer en tekstschrijver bij Dunique:**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Doe je zoekwoordenonderzoek en optimaliseer je content voor SEO
* Bouw en beheer je Google Ads-campagnes (SEA)
* Volg je de resultaten en stuur je bij (basiskennis technische SEO is een pre)
* Schrijf je teksten voor onze websites en voor op drukwerk zoals magazines en flyers
* Zit je periodiek met klanten om tafel over resultaten en wensen
* Denk je mee over de strategie, campagnes en branding van onze klanten en natuurlijk Dunique zelf

Je zit dus niet de hele dag achter een bureau. Je bent regelmatig op pad bij klanten, wat zorgt voor een fijne balans. En omdat we klanten vaak al jarenlang kennen, is het contact laagdrempelig en persoonlijk. Een overleg voelt niet formeel, maar als bijpraten, zonder dat het aan professionaliteit inboet. We sturen op resultaat dat de klant merkt en begrijpt, niet op pagina’s dikke rapportages.

**Wie we zoeken**
-----------------

Je hebt ervaring met of een sterke basis in SEO en SEA. Je vindt het net zo leuk om in data te duiken als om met een klant te sparren. Je bent zelfstandig, maar werkt graag samen. Met klanten en met ons team van designers, content creators en developers.

En verder;

* Kun je goed zelfstandig en in teamverband werken
* Heb je creatieve ideeën te over
* Ben je communicatief vaardig: je weet je ideeën en advies duidelijk over te brengen
* Kun je snel schakelen tussen (kleine) opdrachten
* Werk je nauwkeurig en gestructureerd
* Het betreft een functie van 20 tot 24 uur per week (tijd en werkdagen in overleg)

**Werken bij Dunique betekent…**
--------------------------------

… werken in een enthousiast team dat elkaar helpt en versterkt! Verder:

* staat er dagelijks een lekkere lunch op tafel en lunchen we gezamenlijk;
* zijn er door het jaar heen leuke uitjes, waar jij natuurlijk ook inspraak in hebt;
* sporten we elke maandag na werktijd onder begeleiding van een personal trainer.

We zijn erg benieuwd naar wie jij bent en wat jij allemaal kunt! Ben je ook benieuwd naar ons? Solliciteer dan direct en wie weet drinken we binnenkort gezellig een kop koffie op ons kantoor.

Stuur je motivatie en cv door naar vacatures@dunique.nl

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

job.title: HR Content & Employee Experience Specialist @ ASN Bank (Utrecht, UT, NL)
job.description:
Plaats Utrecht, Croeselaan 1 / Utrecht, Croeselaan 1 Werktijden 36 uur € 4.552,48 € 6.069,97

  

**Als HR Content & Employee Experience Specialist bij ASN Bank in Utrecht zorg jij dat medewerkers en leidinggevenden snel de juiste HR-informatie vinden. Of het nu gaat om arbeidsvoorwaarden, verlof of persoonlijke ontwikkeling: jij maakt complexe informatie begrijpelijk, toegankelijk en eenvoudig vindbaar. Zo verbeter je de medewerkerservaring en maak je onze HR-dienstverlening elke dag een stukje makkelijker.**

**Wat ga je doen?**
  
Als HR Content & Employee Experience Specialist ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de centrale HR-informatievoorziening aan medewerkers en leidinggevenden. Vanuit het People Experience Center zorg je dat zij op het juiste moment, via het juiste kanaal, de informatie vinden die ze nodig hebben. Je kijkt daarbij verder dan de inhoud alleen. Hoe zoeken medewerkers naar informatie? Waar lopen ze vast? En hoe kunnen we onze informatievoorziening slimmer en toegankelijker maken? Jij ontdekt wat beter kan en vertaalt deze inzichten samen met de journeyteams en HR-specialisten naar concrete verbeteringen.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

* Je ontwikkelt, beheert en actualiseert HR-informatie in de centrale knowledge library, zodat medewerkers en leidinggevenden snel betrouwbare antwoorden vinden.
* Je zorgt voor een duidelijke, herkenbare en consistente manier van communiceren over HR-producten en diensten, via verschillende kanalen.
* Je verbetert de vindbaarheid en toegankelijkheid van HR-informatie door aan te sluiten op de vragen, behoeften en zoekgedrag van medewerkers en leidinggevenden.
* Je analyseert veelgestelde vragen, zoekgedrag en feedback en vertaalt deze inzichten samen met de journeyteams naar verbeteringen in HR-informatie en de medewerkerservaring.
* Je werkt nauw samen met journeyexperts en HR People Services om informatie op het juiste moment in de medewerkersreis beschikbaar te maken.
* Je signaleert wanneer vragen of knelpunten voortkomen uit beleid, processen of systemen en schakelt met de verantwoordelijke collega’s om verbeteringen in gang te zetten.

**Hier kom je te werken**
  
Je werkt binnen het People Experience Center van ASN Bank. Hier draait alles om een eenvoudige, toegankelijke en prettige HR-dienstverlening voor medewerkers en leidinggevenden. Je werkt nauw samen met journeyteams, HR People Services en andere HR-specialisten. Samen kijken jullie vanuit de medewerkersreis naar wat medewerkers nodig hebben en hoe onze dienstverlening steeds beter kan. De sfeer is open en informeel, met ruimte voor initiatief, feedback en nieuwe ideeën. Je rapporteert rechtstreeks aan de Head of People Experience Center.

**Wat breng jij mee?**
  
Jij weet hoe je complexe informatie vertaalt naar heldere, toegankelijke content. Je begrijpt hoe medewerkers en leidinggevenden informatie zoeken en gebruiken, en ziet kansen om dit makkelijker te maken. Je combineert sterke communicatieve vaardigheden met een analytische blik en werkt graag samen met verschillende HR-specialisten.

Verder heb je:

* Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in communicatie, informatiemanagement of HR.
* Minimaal vier jaar relevante ervaring met informatievoorziening, contentmanagement, communicatie of employee experience.
* Ervaring met het ontwikkelen en beheren van informatie via digitale kanalen, bij voorkeur in een centrale kennisomgeving of knowledge library.
* Kennis van HR-dienstverlening en inzicht in de behoeften van medewerkers en leidinggevenden.
* Ervaring met het analyseren van zoekgedrag, veelgestelde vragen en feedback om informatievoorziening te verbeteren.
* Affiniteit met journeygericht werken en het verbeteren van de medewerkerservaring.

**Wat krijg je van ons?**
  
Deze functie valt in schaal 9, met een bruto maandsalaris tussen €4.552,48 en € 6.069,97 (op basis van 36 uur per week).

Verder bieden wij:

* Een flexibel in te delen 36-urige werkweek, zoals 4x9 en thuiswerken
* 8% vakantiegeld en een 13e maand, op een moment dat het jou goed uitkomt
* Op basis van een fulltime dienstverband: 208,8 uur verlofuren per jaar
* Een goede collectieve pensioenregeling
* € 750,- per jaar om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen (te sparen tot € 3.000,-)
* Elke 5 jaar € 900,- om je thuiswerkplek weer helemaal op orde te maken
* Een NS-Business Card en een kilometervergoeding voor als je op de fiets komt

Nieuwsgierig naar de rest? Lees hier alles over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.

**Over ons**
  
ASN Bank is een toegankelijke en vooruitstrevende bank met oog voor mens, maatschappij en de toekomst. We dragen op duurzame wijze bij aan financiële oplossingen voor onze klanten én aan maatschappelijke vraagstukken in Nederland. Daarbij hebben we bijzondere aandacht voor duurzaamheid, financieel welzijn en goed wonen. Als bank combineren we het gemak van veilig mobiel bankieren met de kracht van persoonlijk advies. Dankzij ons landelijk dekkend netwerk van kantoren zijn we ook fysiek dichtbij op de momenten die ertoe doen.

**Word onze collega**
  
Maak jij je sterk voor morgen? Solliciteer dan vandaag bij ASN Bank. Upload je motivatie en cv, dan nemen we snel contact met je op. De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en een assessment. Voor meer informatie kun je terecht bij Femke Kessler, corporate recruiter, via femke.kessler@asnbank.nl.

für unsere Zentrale in Bindlach  

ONLINE BEWERBEN
